subject: Medford Square Parking Lot Redevelopment Proposal
overview: The Committee of the Whole met to receive a presentation and discuss a proposal to redevelop three municipal parking lots in Medford Square under a 99-year ground lease. No votes were taken on the project, which will require future council approvals for surplus property designation and zoning amendments.

items.title: Discussion on Medford Square Parking Lots Redevelopment Proposal
items.summary: The Committee reviewed paper 25178 and received a presentation on a proposal to lease three city parking lots to Transom Real Estate for a mixed-use development featuring approximately 300 residential units, a grocery store, and a parking garage.
